title: RenderKit 2D — Inspectable Visuals
audience: Researchers, engineers and AI agent developers

slides.title: Clustering starts with an assumption
slides.keyMessage: Choose the algorithm to match the geometry of the problem.

blocks.text:
K-MEANS

Assign each point to its nearest centroid.
Update centroids and repeat.

Best suited to compact, roughly spherical groups.
Requires the number of clusters k.

DBSCAN

Expand clusters through dense neighborhoods.
Label isolated observations as noise.

Can recover irregular cluster shapes.
Sensitive to ε and minPts.

slides.title: The K-Means objective
slides.keyMessage: Minimize within-cluster squared distance to the centroids.

blocks.caption: Cⱼ is a cluster; μⱼ is its centroid.

blocks.text:
Assignment and centroid updates alternate until convergence.
The objective can reach a local minimum; initialization matters.
Feature scaling affects the distance metric.
